name: 自动线路命名 | Auto Line Names
summary: 分类编号、多种格式、双语标签和批量预览，保护手动名称。Stable numbers, templates and batch previews; protects custom names.
description:
中文说明

自动为新线路生成包含交通类别、客货类型、地点和分类编号的名称。手动名称受到保护。

默认格式：
• [铁路客运] 北京-天津-001
• [铁路货运] 煤炭-矿山-钢厂-001

功能：
• 公交、卡车、电车、铁路、船舶、飞机、直升机，以及客货混运。
• 各交通类别与客货类型独立编号；改变站点或货物保留编号，删除线路不重新排序。
• 完整、原始、紧凑及自定义模板；城市、城市简称、站点或实际服务产业作为地点。
• 货物全名、简称、代码和逐项覆盖；默认最多三种货物，更多显示 +N。
• 可选 LO / IC / RE 区域分类。
• 标签和界面跟随游戏语言，提供中文、英文，其他语言回退英文；地名和货物名保留游戏名称。
• 首次启用保留已有线路；手动改名或 Cst 前缀停止自动覆盖。将名称设为 r 或 reload 可恢复自动命名。
• 线路管理器内批量预览，确认后接管并持续更新。默认跳过受保护名称，可明确选择包含。
• 高级配置保存到当前存档，Mod 更新后仍保留。
• 新线路每两秒发现，自动管理线路默认每 60 秒复核，每次最多处理 64 条。

使用：在载入选项选择格式、语言、地点、货物样式及复核间隔。高级模板和标签在 content/user_config.lua 编辑，重启游戏后在线路管理器执行“重新载入配置”。至少两个不同停靠点，交通类型不明时等待。

仅修改名称，停用后已生成名称保留。无需其他 Mod。封面为 AI 生成示意图。

revision 4：修复 Build 40408 的 get_native 致命断言，保留配置、自动管理状态及编号。71 项自动化检查通过，包括 5000 条模拟线路；游戏内检查以随包验证记录为准。更新后请重启游戏。

English Description

Automatically names new lines with transport type, service, places and stable category numbers. Protects manually assigned names.

Default formats:
• [Train Passenger] Beijing-Tianjin-001
• [Train Cargo] Coal-Mine-Steel Mill-001

Features:
• Buses, trucks, trams, trains, ships, aircraft, helicopters and mixed passenger/cargo services.
• Independent numbering per transport/service category. Stop and cargo changes retain numbers; deleting lines does not renumber others.
• Full, original, compact and custom formats; town names, abbreviations, stations or industries actually served by a station.
• Full cargo names, abbreviations, codes and overrides. Shows up to three items followed by +N for additional items.
• Optional LO / IC / RE classification.
• Chinese and English labels/UI follow game language, with English fallback. Place and cargo names retain game-provided names.
• Preserves existing lines on first activation. Manual renames and the Cst prefix stop automatic changes. Rename to r or reload to resume.
• Batch preview in the line manager. Confirmation enables ongoing automatic updates; protected names are excluded unless explicitly included.
• Advanced configuration is stored in each savegame and survives mod updates.
• Discovers new lines every two seconds; reviews managed lines every 60 seconds by default, with at most 64 lines processed per update.

Usage: choose format, language, place/cargo style and refresh interval in the mod loading options. Edit content/user_config.lua for advanced templates and labels, restart the game, then select Reload configuration in the line manager. Lines need two distinct stops; ambiguous transport types wait for more information.

Changes names only. Names remain after disabling. No dependencies. Cover: AI-generated illustration.

Revision 4 fixes the fatal get_native assertion in Build 40408, preserving saved settings, management state and numbering. All 71 automated checks pass, including 5,000 simulated lines; consult the bundled validation record for in-game checks. Restart the game after updating.
